    Home/Weight loss/GLP-1 pills

    GLP-1 pills for weight loss, compared with what clinics charge.

    Peptide Chooser editorial team. Checked 30 Oct 2026.

    Every claim links to its source.

    Two pills are FDA approved for weight loss: Wegovy taken by mouth (semaglutide) and Foundayo (orforglipron), which is not a peptide. Ozempic and Rybelsus tablets are semaglutide approved for type 2 diabetes, not for weight loss.

    Compare the options

    Is it legal today?

    For losing weight with a pill instead of a shot: the approved pills, what they cost, and the copies sold online.

    • Wegovy pill (semaglutide) · daily pill for weight lossFDA approvedon prescription

      A daily pill on prescription: Wegovy, semaglutide's weight-management brand, taken by mouth.

      In a 64-week trial in adults with obesity or overweight, people lost 13.6% of body weight on the pill, against 2.2% on placebo. 1, 2, 3

      FDA approved for weight management.

      Prescription.

      On prescription; no clinic prices yet
    • Foundayo (orforglipron) · daily pill for weight loss, not a peptideFDA approvedon prescription

      A daily pill on prescription for adults with obesity, or overweight with a weight-related health problem. Not a peptide.

      In a 72-week trial in 3,127 adults with obesity, people lost 7.5% to 11.2% of body weight, by dose, against 2.1% on placebo. 4, 5

      FDA approved for weight management.

      Prescription.

      On prescription; no clinic prices yet
    • Ozempic or Rybelsus tablets · diabetes pill, not for weight lossFDA approvedon prescription

      Semaglutide tablets on prescription, approved for type 2 diabetes, not for weight loss.

      Approved to improve blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes, and to lower the risk of heart attack, stroke and heart death in those at high risk. 6

      FDA approved for type 2 diabetes, not for weight loss.

      Prescription.

      On prescription; no clinic prices yet
    • Compounded semaglutide tablets · pharmacy-made tabletsNot FDA approved; pharmacy-madeon prescription

      Semaglutide tablets mixed by a pharmacy, sold by online clinics on prescription. Not FDA approved.

      Pharmacy-made copies. The FDA does not check their safety, effectiveness or quality before they are sold. 7

      Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made.

      Prescription through the clinic.

      On prescription; no clinic prices yet

    Questions about glp-1 pills

    What are the best glp-1 pills?

    Two pills are FDA approved for weight loss: Wegovy taken by mouth (semaglutide) and Foundayo (orforglipron), which is not a peptide. The options on this page: Wegovy pill (semaglutide), daily pill for weight loss; Foundayo (orforglipron), daily pill for weight loss, not a peptide; Ozempic or Rybelsus tablets, diabetes pill, not for weight loss; Compounded semaglutide tablets, pharmacy-made tablets.

    Are glp-1 pills FDA approved?

    FDA approved: Wegovy pill (semaglutide), Foundayo (orforglipron) and Ozempic or Rybelsus tablets. Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made: Compounded semaglutide tablets. Each status has its source under "Is it legal today?".

    Do I need a prescription for glp-1 pills?

    On prescription: Wegovy pill (semaglutide), Foundayo (orforglipron), Ozempic or Rybelsus tablets and Compounded semaglutide tablets.
